comment: Advisories that npm audit --omit dev may report without failing the build. Every entry needs an expiry so an unfixable advisory cannot silently become permanent; see docs/security.md, 'Dependency pinning and supply chain'.

exceptions.reason: No patched release exists (all versions <= 6.2.0 affected). Reachable only via the vendored prime-agent proxy chain (pac-proxy-agent -> get-uri -> basic-ftp) when a proxy is configured with an ftp:// URL, which Catfish-Pi never sets; exploitation also requires a malicious FTP server answering Client.list(). Track upstream and remove once a fixed basic-ftp ships.
